hints.selectNone: Click a building to edit it, or draw one with the rectangle (R) or the polygon (P).
hints.select: Drag a vertex, the « + » of an edge to add one, the building to move it. Delete removes the selected vertex; double-click a dimension to type it. Alt: no snapping.
hints.rect: Drag to draw a rectangle. Alt: no snapping.
hints.polygon: Click to place the vertices; close on the first vertex, by double-clicking or with Enter. Backspace removes the last one, Escape abandons.

ai.title: Artificial intelligence (datasheet reading)
ai.notConfigured: No key configured: datasheet reading is disabled.
ai.envOverride: The ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable is set: it is used instead of the stored key.
ai.saved: The key is saved in the system credential store.

result.invalid: Anthropic refuses this key (invalid or revoked).
result.inconclusive: Anthropic did not confirm the key right now: try again later.

ai.storeUnavailable: The system credential store is not available on this computer: the key cannot be saved.
ai.privacy: The key is kept by the operating system (Windows Credential Manager, macOS Keychain) and never shown again. Testing it costs nothing; each datasheet read is billed by Anthropic.
ai.help: Create a key in the Anthropic Console (console.anthropic.com), under API keys.
